documents.text: Liquid coolant flows through battery cold plates and carries cell heat to a radiator. This circuit prevents the battery pack from overheating.
The passenger cabin air conditioner cools air before blowing it through dashboard vents. It does not circulate liquid through battery cells.
The battery controller balances the electrical charge of individual cells to reduce voltage differences. Balancing is unrelated to removing heat.
Inspect the incoming ventilation air filter every six months. The filter captures dust before air reaches the passenger compartment.
Replace the hydraulic oil filter after 500 operating hours. It removes metal particles from the lift circuit rather than filtering cabin air.
Pressing the emergency stop button opens the safety relay, which disconnects electrical power to the drive motor immediately.
A normal software stop gradually slows the drive motor while its power relay remains closed. It is not an emergency power disconnection.
The data retention policy removes exported reports after 30 days. Audit events are kept for one year.
Database backups are retained for 90 days before removal. This schedule does not apply to exported reports.
